evidence_quotes.O: As background, I put together my own home theater systems many times, latest with high-end receivers, and carefully calibrated 7.1 surround.
evidence_quotes.C: All memory tests passed. The Windows Experience Index (WEI) reported 7.7 (out of 7.9 max).
evidence_quotes.E: I find myself having fun wiping the entire collection of CDs, DVDs, and blu-ray discs
evidence_quotes.A: Great to know from other reviews that the reverse audio transmission works as well and will get another one when I need to do so.
evidence_quotes.N: Putting on a protective film layer is 10x harder than on iPhone, due to larger area and chances for more bubbles. I wasted 4 sheets before succeeding.
